report_name: New 'Majinahanashi' Ransomware Group Hits Hospitality Sector

threat_actors.name: Majinahanashi
threat_actors.description: A newly identified ransomware group targeting a diverse range of industries globally, including the hospitality, retail, e-commerce, manufacturing, healthcare, and technology sectors. The group operates a double-extortion model, exfiltrating data before encryption.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through a double-extortion model involving data exfiltration and encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: The Majinahanashi ransomware terminates a long list of processes and services related to security software (antivirus, EDR) and backup applications.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The Majinahanashi ransomware deletes Volume Shadow Copies using vssadmin.exe and disables the Windows System Restore feature to prevent recovery.

attack_patterns.name: Clear Windows Event Logs
attack_patterns.description: The Majinahanashi ransomware clears Windows event logs to erase forensic traces of the attack.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The Majinahanashi group steals data from victims before encryption as part of their double-extortion model.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Majinahanashi ransomware encrypts files using a hybrid AES-256 and RSA encryption scheme, appending the .majin extension.

malware.name: Majinahanashi Ransomware
malware.description: A Windows-based ransomware that exfiltrates data before encrypting files with a hybrid AES-256 and RSA encryption scheme. It appends the .majin extension to encrypted files and drops a ransom note named README.txt. It also performs defense evasion and inhibits system recovery.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by the Majinahanashi ransomware to delete Volume Shadow Copies to inhibit system recovery.

identities.name: The Margo Hotel
identities.description: A hotel in the UK targeted by the Majinahanashi ransomware group.

identities.name: Grand Ion Delemen Hotel
identities.description: A hotel in Malaysia targeted by the Majinahanashi ransomware group. The attackers claimed to have stolen 5,045 files.

indicators.name: Majinahanashi VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Majinahanashi Ransomware VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8c1d3e-4f5a-4b6c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects the command used by Majinahanashi ransomware to delete Volume Shadow Copies.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-21-aug-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-21
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
      - '/all'
      - '/quiet'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of vssadmin.exe to delete all volume shadow copies, a common ransomware behavior to inhibit system recovery, as used by Majinahanashi.

indicators.name: Majinahanashi Event Log Clearing
indicators.pattern:
title: Majinahanashi Ransomware Event Log Clearing
id: 3c4d5e6f-7a8b-4c9d-0e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
status: experimental
description: Detects the command used by Majinahanashi ransomware to clear Windows event logs.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-21-aug-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-21
tags:
  - attack.t1070.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' cl '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of wevtutil.exe to clear event logs, a technique used by Majinahanashi ransomware to cover its tracks.

indicators.name: Majinahanashi Ransomware File Artifacts
indicators.pattern:
title: Majinahanashi Ransomware File Artifacts
id: 4d5e6f7a-8b9c-4d0e-1f2a-3b4c5d6e7f8a
status: experimental
description: Detects file creation events associated with Majinahanashi ransomware, such as encrypted files with the .majin extension or the ransom note.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-21-aug-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-21
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.majin'
  selection_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\README.txt'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with the '.majin' extension or the ransom note 'README.txt', which are definitive indicators of a Majinahanashi ransomware infection.
